payload.rationale: This is a minimal test memory — a single declarative sentence by Tanya verifying that an omitted git ref defaults to topic branch creation. I surfaced the core witness-depth items already returned by the perspective: the sample itself, the default-ref narrative, Tanya's verbatim observation, her actor record, and the three style observations (direct tone, first-person quote attribution, technical jargon) plus style metrics. I also included Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning as the broader product context since Tanya is the CEO and this test lives within her product's infrastructure. I deliberately did NOT expand the children of Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning (pricing, target market, product category, anti-pattern positioning) because this infrastructure test document does not bear on those positioning decisions. I also excluded the Sprint 4 retro and product vision samples as they are thematically unrelated to a git-ref defaulting test.
